source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.

morphology_documented.habit: Deciduous tree of low woods, lakeshores and stream banks
morphology_documented.leaves: Deeply five-lobed with sharp V-shaped sinuses and coarsely toothed lobes
morphology_documented.flowers: Apetalous greenish/reddish flowers before or with leaves
morphology_documented.fruit: Paired samara with V-shaped sinus, lengths to 50(–60) mm
